mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 0.3 percentage points signals stronger household income and consumer demand, which raises earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month decline in the Housing Starts Index exceeding 10% signals weakening residential investment and lower durable-goods demand, which reduces earnings visibility and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST declines by more than 10% over 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below -0.5% signals deteriorating manufacturing activity and lower corporate revenues, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO falls by more than 0.5% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals labor market overheating and higher wage pressures, which increases cost-of-living concerns and reduces consumer discretionary spending, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 1% signals reduced consumer purchasing power, which lowers demand for equities and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS declines by more than 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in CPI inflation above 0.5 percentage points signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the probability of aggressive Fed tightening and supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL declines by more than 0.5pp over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
